pkgmetadata.longdescription: QindaHane: a native QindaQt drawing and painting application built on Tiltmark, the physical-media brush engine of HANE by Sloom. Pencils, charcoal, inks, markers, watercolor, gouache, acrylic and oils with finite implement reservoirs, wet paper physics and drying. Proprietary prebuilt binary; the archive is cut from the qinda build.
